mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate accommodative monetary policy.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE increases >0.3pp over 3 months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in labor force participation (PAYEMS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate broad-based consumer demand weakness, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both PAYEMS and HOUST decline, or interaction effect Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 2.5% and rising), higher discount rates reduce equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 2.5% and rising, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL exceeding 255 (indicating accelerating inflation) triggers expectations of aggressive Fed tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 255, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In supply contraction regimes (INDPRO < 105), manufacturing output declines reduce corporate profitability, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 105, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous FEDFUNDS > 2.5% and UNRATE > 4.0% signals dual monetary tightening and labor market weakness, generating negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 2.5% and UNRATE > 4.0%, or interaction effect Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts falling below 1200 (thousands of units) indicates residential sector weakness that reduces consumer confidence and corporate investment, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when HOUST < 1200, or Rank IC < 0.03.
